items.label: 2FT DEPTH
items.value: 24 inches of depth holds up to 215 gallons of soil-ideal for medium to deep root plants and vegetables like broccoli, beans, and more. Note: This product does not include a bottom panel

items.label: MULTIPLE CONFIGURATIONS
items.value: A modular design allows you to enjoy this bed in one of six setups; 8 curved and 16 straight panels come together in one or two-foot variations

items.label: EASY-REACH GARDEN BED
items.value: While the 8-foot length provides ample planting space, the 2-foot width and height allow you to access your garden for easy upkeep without constant bending and kneeling

items.label: BUILT TO LAST
items.value: Made of powder-coated steel panels, this garden bed is the perfect, sturdy planter for romaine lettuce, cucumbers, strawberries and other seasonal crops

items.label: TOOL-FREE ASSEMBLY
items.value: Beveled steel panels come together with a set of included wingnuts and bolts with rubber edging for your added protection; OVERALL DIMENSIONS: 96"(L) x 24"(W) x 24"(H)
